title: Approve architecture governance capability v0.1
body: The owner approves the following as **architecture governance capability v0.1**, to be used for every major design: | Approved element | Where | |---|---| | Twelve hard constraints and the rule that none can be waived | [HARD-CONSTRAINTS](../architecture/HARD-CONSTRAINTS.md) | | Ten review perspectives and their verdicts (Pass, Concern, Fail, Not assessed) | [REVIEW-PERSPECTIVES](../architecture/REVIEW-PERSPECTIVES.md) | | Five review checkpoints CP1 to CP5 | [REVIEW-CHECKPOINTS](../architecture/REVIEW-CHECKPOINTS.md) | | Design-review gate rules (reject, block, approvable; structure rules ST-1 to ST-12; decision-status rule; figures lint) and its limits | [DESIGN-REVIEW-GATE](../architecture/DESIGN-REVIEW-GATE.md) | | Defence question bank (60 questions, 21 critical) | [DEFENSE-QUESTION-BANK](../architecture/DEFENSE-QUESTION-BANK.md) | | Risk register format and the fourteen risks in it | [RISK-REGISTER](../architecture/RISK-REGISTER.md) | | Design, review-record and ADR (template v2) templates | [templates/](../architecture/templates/) | | Governance roles, skills `design-authoring`, `design-review`, `design-defense`, and the rule that no agent can approve or accept | [GOVERNANCE](../architecture/GOVERNANCE.md) | | Automated checks: `design-gate.mjs`, `validate-architecture.mjs` | `harness/scripts/` | **Not approved by this decision:** - DES-0001 as a design, and ADR 0004. They remain Blocked and Proposed. DES-0001 and RV-0001 are approved only as a worked demonstration of the process. - Any waiver, any design approval, and the naming of a human decider. Naming deciders is deferred by the owner (TODO T3). Until a decider is named, the gate cannot produce a valid Approved status, so no design can be Approved. - The decision register (all 37 decisions stay open and deferred).
subject: adr.0005
